title: Conditional Localized Path
description: A conditional localized path override. When the condition evaluates to true, these paths and defaultPath are used instead of the base paths/defaultPath.

defaultPath.description: The default path to use when the condition is met and the user's locale does not match any of the localized paths.

paths.description: The localized paths to use when the condition is met.

condition.description: The condition that must evaluate to true for this override to apply.
